newsitem.title: USA: Lucent Technologies forms fingerprint firm.
newsitem.headline: Lucent Technologies forms fingerprint firm.

text.p: Telecommunications equipment giant Lucent Technologies Inc said Wednesday it and venture capital firm U.S. Venture Partners will form an electronic fingerprint identification business.

The new company, Veridicom Inc, will offer products intended to facilitate identification when face-to-face identification is not possible, Lucent said in a press release. Veridicom's products also will make it easier for consumers to protect against impersonation attempts, it said.
The Menlo Park, Calif.,-based company's first product, a fingerprint identification pad the size of a postage stamp, will be available later this year, Lucent said.

Users simply touch the pad with their fingertips to access protected information, use equipment, initiate a transaction or enter a restricted area, Lucent said. The product can be used on its own or in tandem with such equipment as laptop computers, cellular phones, cash registers and automatic teller machines or with other security measures such as keys and digital signatures.
The technology behind the product was developed by Bell Labs, the research and development arm of Lucent.
